title: Exact sparse spectrum Goldreich–Levin input
statement: Given natural numbers $n$ and $k$ and a proof that $n>0$, take the deterministic Goldreich–Levin input whose accuracy parameters are those prescribed by the exact sparse spectrum construction for $n$ and $k$, and whose integral Fourier $1$-norm bound is the exact sparse spectrum sparsity bound at $k$.
caveat: The formal statement refers to the accuracy construction and sparsity-bound lower-bound result without including their definitions.
